claims.text: The ride deviated. The platform's own optimal route for this booking was 14.0 km (EV-TRIP-00107, optimal_route_source 'routing-engine-v3.2'), while the driver's GPS polyline covers 17.57 km (EV-GPS-00107, derived.deviation.trace_distance_km) - an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5% of optimal. Both POL-RD-01 gates pass: the excess is greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20% of optimal, so the deviation is ESTABLISHED, and it is established on the trace figure, which governs over the rounded trip_record copy. I disclose that EV-GPS-00107 is IMPAIRED at weight 0.30 on the pre-pass, with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED, and I do not present it as clean evidence.

The GPS impairment does not reach policy level. Under POL-RD-07 a trace is impaired for policy purposes only on a gap over 90 seconds, a straight-line jump over 500 m, or a sustained sampling interval over 30 seconds. This trace has no gaps at all (gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0), samples every 10 seconds, and its worst outlier jump is 331.8 m - under the 500 m limb. The deviation may therefore be established on the trace, and the pre-pass down-weighting of EV-GPS-00107 operates under POL-GEN-02 alone, which is a different question.

Corroboration independent of the trace exists, as POL-RD-08 requires here because rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 5 against deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 1, and the excess is under 30%. In EV-CHAT-00107 the rider challenges the Whitley exit - 'why exit at whitley? CTE goes straight down what' - and the driver does not dispute it, replying only 'cte very jam tonight boss', which concedes that he left the CTE. On top of that the driver's counterparty statement on file admits the route outright: 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it.' Both are independent of the GPS trace and both fall within the POL-RD-07(ii) list of corroborating sources.

No closure or advisory exoneration is available. The only traffic advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00107-01, is MISSING at weight 0.0: no congestion advisory was issued for the CTE on the evening of 18 July 2026, and the driver's assertion that CTE was jammed names no artifact. POL-RD-03 requires an advisory that names a road or segment the optimal route traverses and carries a validity window overlapping the pass; there is none, so no excess is exonerated and no closure-adjusted optimal route may be constructed.

The burden has shifted to the driver and he has not discharged it. POL-RD-08 requires the driver, once the rider has shown the excess, to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause to excuse it, and it states expressly that a general assertion that traffic was bad, unsupported by a traffic_advisory ID, does not discharge that burden. The driver's chat reply and his counterparty statement both assert a jam, but cite no advisory, and the advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is missing from the record. The 3.57 km excess therefore stands unexplained.

This was not a rider-requested detour. EV-CHAT-00107 holds only two messages, both sent well into the trip: the rider asking why the driver left the CTE, and the driver answering that it was jammed. There is no rider instruction to go via Newton, Newton Circus or Kim Seng Road, waypoint_hint is null on both messages, and no road is named by the rider. POL-RD-04 is unavailable on this record and excuses no part of the excess.

The refund is arithmetic, not discretionary. This trip is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs against the booked 14.0 km / 24.0 min optimal: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 platform fee = (21.02 x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177. Refund = 36.60 charged_total - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded UP to SGD 7.45. The 1.35 multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00107, which is the only artifact that carries it - the trip_record has no such field, and reading surge as absent would double the figure. The refund is above the 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of charged_total, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND of 7.45.

POL-RD-11 does not close the distance-refund route on this trip. fare_breakdown.fare_model on EV-FARE-00107 is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null; the rider was billed per kilometre (17.6 km at 0.75) and per minute (34.0 min at 0.28) on a metered card, so the distance and time charges were not fixed at booking and a POL-RD-02 recomputation is the correct remedy.

The rider is presently carrying the entire disputed charge: fare_breakdown.payment_status on EV-FARE-00107 is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00, so the 36.60 has been collected and nothing returned. A PARTIAL_REFUND of 7.45 leaves the rider not carrying the deviated portion of the fare, which is what a rider win means for a rider-filed dispute under POL-GEN-03.

I do not press the POL-RD-06 uplift, because the record does not support it. The excess of 25.5% is below the 50% materiality limb and the 3.57 km excess is below the 8.0 km limb, so this deviation is not MATERIAL; and in any event driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 1 against completed_trips_90d of 619 - below both the count of 3 and the 0.05 ratio the clause requires. No repeat pattern is established, so I claim no FULL_REFUND uplift and no conduct referral on this record.

Escalation is not mandated on this record. The deciding facts are not carried by the 0.30 trace alone: the optimal distance the excess is measured against is carried by EV-TRIP-00107 at weight 1.0, and the route actually driven is independently admitted by the driver in EV-CHAT-00107 at weight 1.0. Under POL-GEN-02(2), where two or more independent artifacts carry the deciding fact the cap is the MAXIMUM of their weights rather than the minimum, so no POL-RD-10(1) confidence-floor trigger fires; and because the trace meets none of the POL-RD-07(a) to (c) limbs, POL-RD-10(3) does not fire either.

claims.text: Even taking the trace's own measurement at face value, the excess is 3.57 km and 25.5% of the 14.0 km optimal route: the two establishment tests in POL-RD-01 pass, but neither materiality gate is close — 25.5% is far short of 50% and 3.57 km is far short of 8.0 km. POL-RD-06 is therefore never engaged on this trip, so no uplift to FULL_REFUND and no driver-conduct referral can attach to it. I disclose that EV-GPS-00107 carries admissibility weight 0.30 and fired the issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED.

The driver's trailing-90-day record is one deviation flag against 619 completed trips. One flag is below the three-flag threshold, and 0.16% is below the 5% ratio floor on a completed-trips base well above 40, so no repeat-deviation pattern is established under POL-RD-06 and limbs (a), (b) and (c) are all unavailable to the rider. His lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter of 2 is context only under POL-GEN-01 and cannot be substituted for the trailing-window figure the clause actually names.

The 3.57 km excess is read off EV-GPS-00107, which the pre-pass admits at weight 0.30 with issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED: a 331.8 m multipath jump at 21:44:57 on the Raffles Place approach, implying 193.6 kph into the outlier and 238.9 kph out of it, inside the very polyline from which the excess is measured, with no drift-corrected figure anywhere in the record. I disclose that impairment. That artifact is also the only carrier of the threshold fact — POL-RD-01 forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test, and the fare meter is derived from the same trace — so under POL-GEN-02(2) the Judge's confidence cannot exceed 0.30, below the 0.70 platform floor, and POL-RD-10(1) requires escalation rather than a final ruling, with the disputed sum held rather than refunded. I accept that the trace is not impaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 (no gap over 90 seconds, a jump under 500 m, a 10-second sampling interval); this is a confidence cap, not a data failure, and the two things must be said separately.

No traffic advisory was issued for the CTE on the evening of 18 July 2026: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING, carries weight 0.0 and fired the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact, and the driver's contemporaneous explanation in the chat ('cte very jam tonight boss') is a general assertion that traffic was bad and cannot discharge his burden under POL-RD-08. He does not ask the tribunal to invent an advisory and does not press POL-RD-03. But a closure defence asserted where the only artifact that could carry it is missing from the pool is exactly the trigger in POL-RD-10(5), and the missing artifact carries nothing adverse to him either: on this record the traffic is unknown, not exculpatory, and the answer is a human reviewer, not a refund.

The rider's 60-day record is five deviation claims with one substantiated, which engages POL-RD-08's corroboration requirement because the excess here is 25.5%, below the 30% line: the claim then needs corroboration beyond the gps_trace from the POL-RD-07(ii) list. Every distance figure the rider can point to is a copy or a meter reading of the platform's single distance measurement — 17.6 km on the trip record is the rounded convenience copy POL-RD-01 forbids citing, and 17.6 km on the fare breakdown is the same measurement on the meter. The driver's own statement admits the route, but the route has never been in dispute; it supplies no independent measurement of the excess, which is what the rider must corroborate.

The rider's complaint folds the 1.35 surge multiplier — SGD 9.28 of the SGD 36.60 charged — into the loss. The multiplier is a booking-time line recorded only on the fare breakdown and is not a consequence of the route driven; POL-RD-02 applies it to the recomputed optimal-route fare, so it cannot be presented as deviation damage.

The fare breakdown carries no ERP gantries (erp_gantries empty), no tolls (tolls_erp 0.0), no airport surcharge, no waiting-time fee and no promo discount, and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0. There is accordingly no pass-through correction and no phantom gantry or wrongly applied surcharge for POL-RD-09 to add on top of any distance figure, and the rider's exposure is confined to the distance-and-time line alone.

ruling.explanation:
Dear both: the trip did deviate, and a partial refund of SGD 7.45 is due to the rider.

RIDER — the route. The platform's optimal route for this booking was 14.0 km, CTE southbound throughout (EV-TRIP-00107). The GPS polyline covering the actual drive is 17.57 km (EV-GPS-00107, trace_distance_km), an excess of 3.57 km, or 25.5%. That passes both establishment tests in POL-RD-01 (greater than 0.8 km and greater than 20%), so the deviation is ESTABLISHED. It does not reach either materiality gate (50% or 8.0 km), so this is an ordinary, not a material, deviation.

On the trace itself, two separate things must be said. It is impaired at the admissibility layer: EV-GPS-00107 carries weight 0.30 and fired the issue codes GPS_DRIFT and IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED (a 331.8 m multipath outlier on the final Raffles Place approach implying impossible speeds). It is NOT impaired for policy under POL-RD-07: there is no gap over 90 s (max_gap_sec 0.0), no jump over 500 m, and the sampling interval is 10 s. The deviation may therefore be established on the trace, and it is; the pre-pass down-weighting speaks to confidence only.

DRIVER — your defence. You took Newton and Kim Seng and say the CTE was jammed. No traffic advisory was issued for that evening: EV-ADVIS-00107-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0). POL-RD-03 accordingly exonerates nothing, and 'cte very jam tonight boss' is a general assertion that traffic was bad, which POL-RD-08 says does not discharge your burden. There was no rider instruction to detour and no amended pickup or dropoff, so POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-05 excuse no part of the excess. No pooled baseline applies.

On the two escalation arguments you raised [cap at 0.30, and POL-RD-10(5)]: both are rejected. The excess is not carried by the 0.30 trace alone. You yourself admitted the route — 'cte very jam tonight boss' in EV-CHAT-00107 (weight 1.0), and 'I went by Newton and Kim Seng to avoid it' in your statement, an admission against your own interest — so an artifact independent of the trace carries the deciding fact, and under POL-GEN-02(2) the cap is the MAXIMUM of the independent weights, not the minimum. Confidence is 0.85, above the 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) does not fire. POL-RD-10(5) does not fire either: an assertion that cites no advisory is a burden matter under POL-RD-08, not a clause invoked against an absent artifact. The trip identifiers match, the timestamps agree, every charge line has a counterpart, and the refund is far below the escalation ceiling, so no other POL-RD-10 trigger applies.

Refund (POL-RD-02). charged_total = 36.60. recomputed_fare = ((3.80 + 0.75 x 14.0 + 0.28 x 24.0) x 1.35) + 0.80 = 29.177. refund = 36.60 - 29.177 = 7.423, rounded up to SGD 7.45. The 1.35 multiplier was read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier on EV-FARE-00107 (the only artifact that carries it) and is applied to the recomputed fare, so it is not refunded as such. The 7.45 is above the 0.50 de minimis and far below 90% of the charge, so the outcome is a PARTIAL_REFUND and the rider keeps the balance.

No POL-RD-06 uplift or conduct referral: the deviation is not material and the driver's trailing-90-day record is 1 flag against 619 trips, below both POL-RD-06 tests — his lifetime prior_deviation_flags of 2 is context only under POL-GEN-01. No POL-RD-09 correction: this trip carries no ERP gantries, no tolls and no surcharge, and refund_issued_sgd is 0.00.
